derivations.sheets: resources.mbs (see _tools/extract/mbs.cjs): animation width/height are the whole sheet; frame = width/across x height/down; per-frame durations in ms; origin (ox, oy) is the scale/mirror pivot.
derivations.actorPlacement: createRecycledActor(type, x, y) places the default animation top-left at (x, y); setAnimation preserves the actor centre (verified live on map 152: w4a2 getX 428, xCenter 458, 60x60 frame). Monster centre = (x + 25, y + 25) from the 50x50 mushG default; player centre = (x + 47, y + 25) from 94x50; Bullet (sprite 8) centre = (x + 12.5, y + 12.5); Bullet2 (576) centre = (x + 34.5, y + 18); ItemDrop centre = (x + 20, y + 20); Portal centre from its default frame.
derivations.backgrounds: "scripts.ActorEvents_81" init (line 102157): groups pushed into _AllMapsForAnimationX; image = i + "bg.png" (1200x675) attached at (0,0) to StaticBG (scene actor type 81, y = bgY0). Loop has no break, so the last matching group wins. Map 41 joins group TournyStuff[42][OptionsListAccount[614]] (bgByOla614). Map-only filters: 38 saturation 0, 165 hue 345, 212/213 saturation 60, 260/261 alpha 0.6; map 166 Rift hue and class/buff filters are runtime-dependent and not applied.
derivations.parallax: _event_Updating (line 102154), viewport 960x540: if sceneW > 970, bgX = round(screenX - screenX / (sceneW - 960) * 240); if sceneH > 550, bgY = round(screenY + bgY0 - screenY / (sceneH - 540) * 135), except map 259 bgY = round(580 + screenY / (sceneH - 540) * 48).
derivations.sceneBackground: Scene MBS layer list (pointer at scene struct +89, dynamic typeId/addr pairs; loader ~19095-19130). Type 30 ColorBackground fills the screen (sky.color; most scenes white), type 31 GradientBackground is a vertical two-colour gradient (sky.top/bottom), type 34 ImageBackground layers reference resources.mbs Background resources (copied from assets/graphics/1x/background-<id>-0.png). All combat-scene layers have customScroll false and repeating models with parallax 0, so BackgroundLayer.load (~20540) makes a screen-fixed ScrollingBitmap; a nonzero xVelocity (ScrollingBackground, ~14023) drifts floor(xP) with xP += xVelocity / 10 per engine update, wrapping at the repeated image width, and drawRepeated tiles the image up to the 960x540 screen. These sit behind the AE81 StaticBG (whose sky is transparent on e.g. 6bg.png).
derivations.platforms: SceneEvents_N init sets getGameAttribute("Platforms")[1] = P; ActorEvents_67 attaches addImgInst("Plat" + P + ".png") at scene (0,0), so platform pixels equal node geometry coordinates.
derivations.monsters: Actor type "Monster" (sprite 2). ActorEvents_1 animation: Tree type -> "Tree" frozen at DeathFrame; BugNest -> "Bugs" frozen at DeathFrame; Bug type -> "Bug" plus <type>real.png overlays; types containing demonP/mushP/ChestA-D use that animation; otherwise the type name. Idle frames 0..MovingFrame-1 (0..DeathFrame-2 when MovingFrame = 0), walk MovingFrame..DeathFrame-2, death (Monster/Ore types only) DeathFrame..end then fadeTo(0, 0.5s); faces right, mirrored (growTo(-size, size)) while moving left. Size: growTo(SizeMulti) with SizeMulti 2 default, 1 for pets, 5 giants, 3 pirate/arcane/party, 8 super giants; super giants also get HueFilter(180).
derivations.player: Actor type "Player" (sprite 21); animation names match the sim p.animation; scale 2 (_PlayerSize 200), mirrored when _PlayerDirection = 0 (facing left). Hair/face are part of the sprite 21 body sheet; equipped gear is composited from separate actors (see gear).
derivations.gear: Gear layers follow the player actor and copy its growTo(±2, 2); positions are setX/setY of the layer actor (top-left of its current frame), so pivot = (X + ox, Y + oy) with X = P.getX() (= sim x) + offset. Weapon (ActorEvents_24, sprite 25, src ~72952-72971): WF = ItemDefinitions[EquipOrder[0][1]].ID (-1 for "2*" anims except "2_"; anims 5-20 except 9 use tool EquipOrder[1][anim-5]); "2*" -> same anim frame pFrame + WF * TotalFramesPerSpriteForAnimationABC[anim]; "0"/"4" -> WF + NumberOfWeaponsMAP[Type]; "9"/"Za" -> fist: anim "1", else same anim (absent in sprite 25, so the previous anim is kept); "1" -> anim "0" frame WF + NumberOfWeaponsMAP[Type] (fist 0); "5"/"6" pFrame + 12WF; "7" +21WF; "8" +17WF; "D*" -> anim "1"; else pFrame. Offsets: "0" Y+2 on frames 0/3/4 (fist 0/1/4); "1" Y -4/-2/0; "2_" (+14,+11); "2a" (-28,-40); "2c" (0,-30); "7" (-18,+16); "8" (-13,-30); "Za" Y + 2|pFrame-4|. Z: idle "0" with a non-fist weapon draws behind the body, otherwise in front. Helmet (ActorEvents_31, sprite 32, src ~77295-77322): hidden actor whose frame (ID+2 of premium helmet EquipOrder[0][8] unless Blank/EquipmentHats38, else helmet EquipOrder[0][0]; anim "4" while the player is "4", else "1") is copied to an image attached to the player at local (32 + AnimationOffsets[k][pFrame], AnimationOffsets[k][pFrame + N]) and brought to front; anim "4" uses (0,-5). Cape (ActorEvents_573, sprite 574, src ~88801-88844): animation "" + ID(EquipOrder[0][12]) on its own timer at (P.getX() ± XYoffsetCape[anim][pFrame], P.getY() + XYoffsetCape[anim][pFrame + round(len/2)]), behind the body except during anim "4". Shirt (ActorEvents_683, sprite 684, src ~97438-97476): animation "" + ID(EquipOrder[0][15]), frame pFrame + per-anim base (1:5, 4:11, 3:15, 2_:22, 2a:39, 2b:50, 2c:63, Za:76, Da:83, 9:93, 5:101, 6:113, 8:125, 7:142), at the player position in front of the body.
derivations.orb: Orb of Remembrance (talent 168) / Verisimilitude (228) cast (src ~67496, skipped when the scene name contains "BOSS") creates ActorEvents_575 Bullet2 (sprite 576) anim 8 at (P.getX() + 8, NodeY[node] - 38) or anim 21 at NodeY - 53, growTo(2,2), sent behind other actors; it fades over 2 s. Kill digits (src ~88863-88922) are unscaled images "<d>_.png" at (orbX + 20 + 12r - 6len, orbY - 60) or "z_<d>.png" at (orbX + 29 + 20r - 10len, orbY - 76) on the middle-layer origin actor.
derivations.bullets: ActorEvents_7 Bullet (sprite 8) keyed by animation name; Warrior totem bullets are ActorEvents_575 Bullet2 (sprite 576) animations keyed WT<anim> (1-14, 16-21), each growTo(2,2). Code-drawn images (AE7 anim >= 100 axes, AE114 thrown FireBomb/PoisonVial, ballista arrows, homing ArrowHM) are copied from assets/data/<name>.png into codeimg/. ActorEvents_209 Buff skill effects (sprite 210) are keyed BF<anim>; they follow the player at per-anim offsets and use growTo(2,2) (Tempest 3, Qnew/Qnew2/TT1 1), unmirrored. Most bullets growTo(2*dir, 2); anims 14/15/25 use 1.5; anim 10 uses -2*dir.
derivations.items: ActorEvents_44 ItemDrop (sprite 45): COIN uses animation "1+r" for the first r with amount < 100^(1+r), else "25"; other items attach "<name>_x1.png" (Cards: "<name>.png") at actor offset (2,2), unscaled. Icons are copied only for MonsterDrops/DropTables entries and literal reward-module items.
derivations.statusAndHpBars: _event_StatusEffectsHPbar (whenUpdated, src ~63518) lays StatusImgInst icons left to right in StatusList order, unscaled, 2 px apart, centred on actor.getX() + round(getWidth() / 2): x = round(getX + offX + DD), DD starting at -0.5 * sum(w + 2); y = round(getY + 30 * (2 - SizeMulti) - MonsterOffsetY + DN4), DN4 = -1 - h while the HP bar is shown (OptionsList[27] = 1), else 16 - h. _event_HPbars (whenDrawing, src 63514) attaches MonsterHPa at (x + offX - 18, y - offY + 7) and MonsterHPb stretched to round(33 * hp / (hpTot + 0.01)) px at (+ offX - 17, + 8); RANDOlist[65] bosses and temp caveB/caveC use DungHP (-100, -10) and PetTotalHP up to 153 px at (-72, +1). While shown, StatusEffectsHPbar repositions both each frame with the 30 * (2 - SizeMulti) term; _event_Movement hides the bar after 20 s without a fill change.
derivations.totems: ActorEvents_575 spawn-skill totems (src ~88863-88907, 89087-89199) attach unscaled digit images on OriginPixelActor[4] from the actor top-left captured when the digits are rebuilt: Wormhole WT13 gi[83] "<d>_p.png" at (x + 24 + 12r - 6len, y - 85); Graveyard WT16 gi[125] "<d>_b.png" at (x + 20 + 12r - 6len, y - 64); Reindeer WT18 gi[132] "<d>_c.png" at (x + 18 + ..., y - 67); Respawn WT9 gi[79] "<d>_b.png" at (x + 20 + ..., y - 60). Digits start at "0", refresh in the 100 ms event while DDB = 1, keep full alpha during the 2 s actor fade, and are removed at recycle. The Arcane Crystal WT19 attaches ArcMeter<type>.png at (x - 13, yCenter - 79) and RankBar.png at (x - 11, yCenter - 77) scaled (135%, 3300% * (1 - min(1, charge / req))); every 20 ms the crystal, meter and bar re-centre on NodeY + 5 Trigg(sin) - 96.
derivations.portals: Scene init: dummyActor = [PortalID, FlipPortal, KillsLeft] then createRecycledActor(getActorType(47), x, y) (top-left). ActorEvents_47 init picks the colour by CurrentMap band and PortalID ("blank" while KillsLeft > 0) and growTo(-1, 1) when FlipPortal = 1.

approximations: Scenery/NPC decoration actors placed in the scene MBS are not drawn.

Player frames are derived from time since the snapshot animation changed (the sim does not record frame indices); the companion pet actor is not drawn; the weapon keeps anim "0" during anims 9/Za because sprite 25 lacks them; the orb digit layer is assumed to be OriginPixelActor[4] (middle world layer, drawn above actors).
Rift (map 166) hue and class/buff background filters and pet hue are not applied; OptionsList[27] (monster HP bars) is a device option represented by the replay HP-bar toggle.
Portal kill gating uses the save-independent coloured animation.
Scene background drift assumes 60 engine updates per second; the whole-map camera tiles screen-fixed background layers across the scene instead of one 960x540 screen.
